title.value: A Diffusion-Model of Joint Interactive Navigation

extractions.description: The paper introduces DJINN, a diffusion model that jointly generates traffic scenarios for all agents in a scene, conditioned on a flexible set of observed agent states and map context. It is evaluated on Argoverse and INTERACTION trajectory forecasting benchmarks and demonstrates goal-based sampling, behavior-class sampling via classifier guidance, and scenario editing.

type.quote: On popular trajectory forecasting datasets, we report state of the art performance on joint trajectory metrics.
type.justification: Trains and evaluates models on datasets with reported metrics.

name.quote: Producing these synthetic traffic scenarios involves generating the joint future motion of all the agents in a scene, a task which is closely related to the problem of trajectory forecasting.
name.justification: The paper's evaluation and contribution target trajectory forecasting / motion prediction.

name.quote: Simulation of autonomous vehicle systems requires that simulated traffic participants exhibit diverse and realistic behaviors.
name.justification: Paper motivates and contributes a traffic scenario generation method for AV simulation.

name.quote: DJINN is a diffusion model over the joint states of all agents in the scene.
name.justification: The contribution is a diffusion-based generative model.
